Default model ids

Source: R/instrument.R
sc_default_models.Rd

The model each provider uses when sc_model() gets no model: The cheapest current model that takes a temperature (claude-haiku-5-5 and gpt-4.1-nano). OpenAI's gpt-5-nano costs less per input token but is a reasoning model that takes no temperature. Ollama has no default: Use a model installed on your machine (ollama list).

Usage

sc_default_models

Format

A named list.

Examples

sc_default_models
#> $anthropic
#> [1] "claude-haiku-5-5"
#> 
#> $openai
#> [1] "gpt-4.1-nano"
#> 
#> $ollama
#> NULL
#> 
#> $mock
#> [1] "mock"
#>
